prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objective, universally “best” lawyer—fit depends on your injuries, the facts, and whether the case may need to go to trial. A practical starting point is the **Houston Lawyer Referral Service**, a State Bar of Texas–certified nonprofit. It offers referrals for car-accident cases and a 30-minute consultation for $20: **713-237-9429** or **800-289-4577**. [Source](https://hlrs.org/for-the-public/areas-of-law/houston-personal-injury-attorneys/car-accidents/)

Before hiring anyone, speak with two or three attorneys and ask:
- Who will personally handle my case?
- How much of your practice involves car-wreck claims like mine?
- What is the contingency fee, and what case expenses could I owe?
- How often do you take cases to trial?
- What are the main strengths and risks in my case?

Check the attorney’s license and disciplinary history through the [State Bar of Texas](https://www.texasbar.com/), and don’t feel pressured to sign during the first call.
